title: One Hour Off-Road Driving Adventure in Las Vegas
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Not recommended for children under 56 inches tall
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Feel the thrill of the Nevada desert on a one hour off-road guided adventure, where adrenaline meets breathtaking landscapes. Hop into a Can-Am Maverick X3, expertly designed for high-speed fun as you navigate through rock climbs, rock washes and sand dunes. With the guidance of highly-trained experts, you can switch drivers halfway, ensuring everyone gets a chance to take the wheel. Chase your guides through the trails just 15 minutes from the Strip, complete with helmets and bottled water for your comfort. Capture lasting memories with photos of your group as you conquer the desert together.
